type: A production UI icon sprite sheet for a children's tactile toy, T-Rex Jelly
goal: Exactly 12 cohesive tactile 3D icons on one transparent canvas, usable as a 4-column by 3-row CSS sprite atlas. This is icon art, not a screenshot or UI mockup.

style.rendering: Premium playful 3D toy sculpture, rounded thick beveled forms, soft studio illumination upper-left, subtle grounded shadow and small glossy highlights. Charming, legible silhouettes appropriate for young children; same view and scale across all icons.
style.material: Smooth soft rubber and candy-like clay. No thin line icons.
style.palette: peach coral, butter yellow, grass green, turquoise, soft violet, creamy highlights; dark teal only for tiny facial details

layout.grid: EXACT 4 equal columns × 3 equal rows. Each icon precisely centered in its equal cell. Canvas aspect ratio 4:3. Every object and shadow stays within the central 72% of its own cell, equal blank transparent gutters.
layout.background: Fully transparent alpha, no backdrop, no white checkerboard, no colored tile or app badge behind icons.
layout.labels: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, captions, logos or watermarks.

icons.object: A coral squishy jelly ball pinched in the middle with a tiny happy face, represents softness
A thick lavender toy coil spring with a small yellow bouncing ball above it, represents wobble settling
A chunky turquoise clockwise circular reset arrow with a soft beveled arrowhead
A butter yellow friendly toy camera with a small curved orbit arrow, represents reset viewpoint
Two thick parallel golden-yellow pause bars, standing side by side
A peach toy hand with palm facing viewer, rounded fingers, two tiny turquoise motion droplets, represents gentle nudge
A chubby smiling green turtle in three-quarter view, represents slow motion
An isometric open cube made of thick turquoise-blue rounded lattice rods, represents show mesh
Four thick violet outward corner arrows arranged as a fullscreen expand symbol
A thick rounded grass-green play triangle pointing right
A plump turquoise toy gear with a butter yellow center
A thick coral rounded X close symbol

must_keep: All 12 specified distinct icons, exactly one per equal cell, same material quality and lighting
Simple immediately readable forms, no microscopic details
Transparent negative space between objects; do not overlap adjacent cells
avoid: More or fewer than twelve icons
